cohort: 182 un-booked obstetric patients aged 18-35 years, both primiparous and multiparous, attending the Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology D.G Khan Hospital D.G Khan between February 2016 and August 2016.
finding: The majority of obstetric women were un-booked, and the C-section rate was very high.
mod_finding: There was no association found between booking status and mode of delivery, but a significant association was found between mode of delivery and education status.
